description: This file defines an immutable class ImmutableAccessControlList implementing the AccessControlList interface, representing an API for managing access control policies, including creation, modification, and serialization of ACL entries.

classes.name: ImmutableAccessControlList
classes.description: Immutable implementation of the AccessControlList interface, managing a collection of ACL entries with methods for merging, setting, removing, and serializing ACL data.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Creates and returns a new empty AccessControlList.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates and returns a new AccessControlList initialized with given ACL entries.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an ACL instance from a JSON object representation.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges an ACL entry or permissions into the existing ACL, returning a new instance.

methods.name: setEntry
methods.description: Sets or replaces an ACL entry, returning a new ACL instance.

methods.name: setForAllAuthorizationSubjects
methods.description: Sets all authorization subjects to the provided permissions, returning a new ACL.

methods.name: getAuthorizedSubjectsFor
methods.description: Retrieves subjects authorized for specific permissions.

methods.name: hasPermission
methods.description: Checks if a given authorization context or subject has specific permissions.

methods.name: getEntryFor
methods.description: Retrieves the ACL entry for a specific authorization subject.

methods.name: getPermissionsOf
methods.description: Returns the permissions assigned to a specific authorization subject.

methods.name: removeEntry
methods.description: Removes an ACL entry for a subject.

methods.name: removePermission
methods.description: Removes specific permissions from a subject.

methods.name: removeAllPermissionsOf
methods.description: Removes all permissions for a specific authorization subject.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the ACL has no entries.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of entries in the ACL.

methods.name: getEntriesSet
methods.description: Returns a set of all ACL entries.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the ACL entries.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the ACL to a JSON object, optionally filtered by a predicate.
